COMMIT and ROLLBACK

COMMIT makes transaction changes permanent; ROLLBACK undoes uncommitted work on transactional
tables.
COMMIT එJකන් changes තහවුරෙැ කරෙනවා. ROLLBACK එJකන් තවම commit Jනාකළ changes ආපසු
ගෙන්නවා. MySQL DDL සමහරෙක් implicit commit කරෙනවා.

Interview question: Can ROLLBACK undo an already committed transaction?
Answer: No; use compensating changes or recovery procedures.
